specialties.name: Fire-master
specialties.intent: You do not aim at units, you aim at ground: the field burns where you point, and everyone has to walk around your work.
specialties.source: Hell-TCG Mage/Fire-master (row Burn rebuilt as burning-terrain painting; the +2 Reach became +1 Reach, which is worth more here) | 2026-08-17 Angela trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Flat 2.

specialties.name: Soul Stealer

specialties.name: Mystic
specialties.intent: You see the fight one beat before it happens: you barely damage anything, and everyone standing near you stops missing.

specialties.name: Storm Caller
specialties.intent: You are the longest reach on the field and the thinnest skin: everything you throw jumps to a second target, and nothing survives touching you.

triggers.effect: your staff attacks deal +2 damage against a target carrying Frost

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Shaman/Storm Caller (kept; the +2 Reach halved because Reach is ranged-only and expensive here) | 2026-08-17 Angela trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: armor -1; health -2. Parked abilities: onTakingDamage: the attacker gains 1 Stun the first time it hits you each Turn.

specialties.name: Totem Master
specialties.intent: You plant your feet and the ground around you becomes yours; the moment you move, every promise you made lapses.

triggers.effect: gain +1 Magic for the rest of the Battle, once

specialties.name: Spirit Walker
specialties.intent: You are the party's second life: you mend what the fight takes, and you pay for it by making everyone's spells a little weaker.

triggers.effect: lay the cold thread on yourself or on one ally within 3 hexes: it gains 1 Frost, which cancels every point of Burn on it as it lands and amplifies the next physical damage it takes.

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Shaman/Spirit Walker (kept; the -1 Magic is new — a healer shaman dilutes the party-wide Magic sum, which is the real cost of taking one) | 2026-08-17 Angela trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. specialties.name: Blightcaller

triggers.effect: every enemy within 2 hexes gains 1 Weak

specialties.name: Wild Shaper
specialties.intent: You gave up half of what a caster is for teeth. You put the Weak on them yourself and then you hit the soft place you just made — nothing else in the game finds a wound this fast.

triggers.effect: your brawl attacks add the target's Weak to their damage. They READ it: the stacks stay on the target and keep working

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Druid/Wild Shaper (HoBaT has no shapeshift system — the forms are rebuilt as a stance and a claw attack, which is why this branch pays 1 Magic to the party sum) | 2026-08-17 Angela trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. powers.name: Fireball

powers.description: Deal 2 + Magic magic damage to every unit in the blast, plus every stack of Burn that unit is already carrying — the blast CONSUMES that Burn — and then those seven hexes become burning. powers.name: Quench
powers.targets: a hex within 4 hexes and every hex adjacent to it
powers.description: Those seven hexes become frost. Frost ground deals no damage, but every unit standing in it takes 2 extra physical damage from every hit — including your own front line. No roll, no crit. Use it to put out a Fire-master’s mess or to soften a knot of enemies for the melee.
powers.source: new (built on the frost terrain status; the anti-fire half of Grove Keeper, which Hell-TCG expressed as a party cleanse) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20 Angela: ground layers are PERSISTENT and carry no number and no clock. A hex is burning or it is not. One layer per hex; applying a different one replaces it. See rule.ground-layers. "Cancelling any burning already on them" is now the universal replacement rule, not this power’s trick.

powers.name: Grove Ward
powers.description: Aura 2, centred on you: allies inside gain +1 Resist and 2 Regeneration.
powers.source: new (replaces Harmony and Sanctuary, both of which were spent on gen/ranger.json) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement.
